n01.roman: 9 November ko Take-Two ke CEO ne bataya: GTA V ab tak duniya bhar mein kareeb 23.5 crore units bik chuka hai.

n02.roman: Aur Bharat ki aabadi? UN ke anumaan se, 2025 mein kareeb 146 crore.

n03.roman: Matlab ye saari copies Bharat mein baant do, toh har 6-7 logon par ek copy!

n04.roman: Twist: agar har copy ek insaan hoti, toh ye GTA desh aabadi mein duniya ka saatvaan sabse bada desh hota, Brazil se bhi bada!

n05.roman: Aur ye kamaal ek hi game ka hai, jo 2013 mein aaya tha. 13 saal baad bhi bik raha hai!
